newsitem.title: PERU: Telefonica del Peru to issue 80 mln soles debt Fri.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica del Peru to issue 80 mln soles debt Fri.

text.p: Telefonica del Peru said Wednesday it will auction Friday through the Lima Stock Exchange 80 million soles (US$30.5 million) of short-term commercial debt paper.
The issue will be offered in two series, A and B, with 30-day and 90-day maturities, respectively, according to the company.

The auction will be the second issue in Telefonica's three-year global program to issue up to $180 million of commercial paper. The company placed $15 million of a first $50 million issue in December.
The issues are intended to increase capital and fund expansion and renovation works.
Local brokerages belonging to Banco Wiese and Banco Continental will handle the placement.
